method: build_review_context actual output; no provider/network/target code execution; each raw TP remains a separate finding; per-finding target-line hashes and context/hunk hashes are post-hoc references, no gold text/source text emitted; hunk body states use raw-source hunk substring against the final per-file rendered patch: complete=full hunk body exact, partial=some body retained, omitted=no body retained. One bare @@ header stub in sdsykes jpeg.rb is recorded separately and remains inside omitted body count; it is not a visible hunk body.

inputs.secondary_group_key: file,start_line,end_line,category(case-insensitive); informational only, never deduplicates the primary raw finding denominator
inputs.gold_mapping: exact path + actual new-side visible line interval; no suffix matching
inputs.hunk_visibility_definition: raw source hunk body comparison against actual rendered per-file patch; bare header stub is separately noted but included in omitted body count
